name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo Mendoza's career began unexpectedly when he stumbled into motorsport while working for a transport company in Lima. He was assigned to handle the logistics for a small rally team competing in the Caminos del Inca, and he immediately fell in love with the organized chaos of the paddock. He learned the intricacies of moving equipment across challenging terrains, dealing with customs regulations, and ensuring that the team had everything they needed, wherever they were. 

Ricardo's meticulous approach and resourcefulness quickly made him an indispensable asset. He is known for his uncanny ability to anticipate problems before they arise, allowing him to proactively implement solutions. Ricardo joined Academy Motorsport a decade ago and has become an essential part of the race operations. His colleagues often remark that 'Ricardo knows where everything is, and if he doesn't, he'll find it before you even realize it's missing.'

While focused on the big picture, Ricardo pays attention to the smallest details, making sure the entire operation runs like clockwork. He's also a firm believer in investing in the next generation, and actively mentors younger team members, sharing his knowledge and experience with them.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking mate in the mornings from a traditional gourd.
